== Summary ==
The '''Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List''' slip of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Virtual Block 1)|I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]] ('''PC-E3''', official text as of 27 April 2013), cropped from the Light Side Master List, p. 24 ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf]]; preserved copy: https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf), with the heading line above the slip. It shows the lower part of the card (the slip), as printed.

* '''Source:''' Players Committee, ''Virtual Cards: Master List'', Light Side, "Official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014), p. 24.
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026, rendered at 200 dpi from the PDF page (PyMuPDF) and cropped; no other change.
* Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text and layout by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
